text: investing in crypto. Most monkeys buy crypto like a stock, buying when the price is low and selling when it's high. At least that's the plan. Some monkeys see crypto value go up, crypto more rare, crypto more valuable. So monkeys get excited and invest in crypto without even thinking about risks. This is called aping. Yes, really. Unlike most stocks, crypto very volatile. If stock market is smooth car ride through countryside, crypto is rocket powered roller coaster. Crypto is still a very new currency. Things like news, rumors, even one monkey tweet can hugely affect crypto price. Some monkeys choose to buy crypto and not sell for a very long time, no matter what happens. This is called Hodling.
